example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভাইয়ের উপর অন্ধের নড়ির মতো নির্ভর করে।
এই চাকরিটি তার জন্য অন্ধের নড়ি।
example_sentences_in_english: He relies on his brother like a blind man on his staff.
This job is his staff of support.
history: This idiom originates from the everyday imagery of a blind person using a staff for navigation, symbolizing essential support in Bengali folklore and proverbs.
note: The idiom draws from universal human experiences but is deeply embedded in Bengali oral traditions.
